# Unregister For Events

![Unregister For Events function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/dialog/events/03-unregister-for-events.svg)

[DialogUserInterface functions](../../dialoguserinterface/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Destroys this registration and discards its pending occurrences. Observed controls, user event sources and independent registrations remain intact. Cleanup executes even with an incoming error and preserves that original error. No valid registration is returned. Expired references are diagnosed and affected waits are cancelled explicitly.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Unregister For Events**

Détruit cette inscription et abandonne ses occurrences en attente. Les contrôles observés, les sources UserEvent et les inscriptions indépendantes restent intacts. Le nettoyage s'exécute même avec une erreur amont, qui reste prioritaire. Aucune référence valide d'inscription ne sort. Les références expirées sont diagnostiquées et les attentes concernées annulées explicitement.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Destroy this registration and discard only its queued events. Cleanup still executes with an upstream error and preserves that initial error. No source object is destroyed and no valid output registration is invented.
